footer.tagline: The world's first high-fidelity geography arcade. Mastering the atlas through immersive design and gamified education.
home.hero.desc: Master world capitals, identify flags, and conquer the map. High-fidelity geography games designed to build global intuition.
home.games.title: Games
home.games.subtitle: Rank up from Explorer to Legend.
home.games.capitalQuiz.title: Capital Quiz
home.games.capitalQuiz.desc: Name the capital of any country in 60 seconds. Builds instant recall of all 195 world capitals.
home.games.mapDash.title: Map Dash
home.games.mapDash.desc: Click the correct country on an unlabeled map before the timer runs out. Sharpens spatial memory.
home.games.flagFrenzy.title: Flag Frenzy
home.games.flagFrenzy.desc: Match flags to their nations across every continent. Learn the stories behind the colors and symbols.
home.loyalty.desc: Unlock themed avatars and game modes as you rise through the ranks.
home.whyGeo.academic.title: Academic Edge
home.whyGeo.academic.desc: Geography underpins subjects from history and economics to environmental science. Students who can locate countries on a map perform better on standardized tests and develop stronger analytical thinking across disciplines.
home.whyGeo.global.title: Global Awareness
home.whyGeo.global.desc: Understanding where nations sit, what borders they share, and how their cultures connect builds empathy and perspective. In an interconnected world, geographic literacy is essential for informed citizenship.
home.whyGeo.learn.title: Learn by Playing
home.whyGeo.learn.desc: Research shows that game-based learning improves retention by up to 90% compared to passive study. Our quizzes use spaced repetition and timed challenges to turn memorization into long-term knowledge.
home.whyGeo.footer: ExploreCapitals covers 195 sovereign nations and 42 territories with interactive games, guided country tours, an explorable atlas, and a searchable database. Whether you are a student preparing for exams, a trivia enthusiast, or a curious traveler, every session strengthens your mental map of the world.
home.exploreSection.title: Explore
home.exploreSection.subtitle: Master the atlas in our interactive database.
home.exploreSection.databaseDesc: Search and sort 195+ countries by capital, population, region, language, and currency.
home.exploreSection.atlasDesc: Pan, zoom, and click any country on an interactive world map to begin a guided tour of its landmarks.
home.howItWorks.title: How It Works
home.howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to geographic mastery.
home.howItWorks.step1.title: Pick a Game
home.howItWorks.step1.desc: Choose from 14 free geography games covering capitals, flags, borders, populations, currencies, landmarks, and more. Each game targets a different skill so your knowledge grows evenly.
home.howItWorks.step2.title: Play and Learn
home.howItWorks.step2.desc: Every round is timed and scored. Correct answers earn points toward your loyalty rank, while wrong answers reveal the right answer so you learn as you go. Sessions are short enough to fit a study break.
home.howItWorks.step3.title: Track Progress
home.howItWorks.step3.desc: Your scores and streaks are saved locally so you can pick up where you left off. Use the country database and atlas to review any nation you missed. Our iOS app is coming soon with cloud sync and more.
